g.text: Schema: Spans Are a Wide, Append-Only, Trace-Sharded Store
Not a relational table -- the query pattern is ALWAYS 'every span for this one trace_id'
cached in memory at the edge,
spans has NO foreign key into sampling_config -- the sampling decision travels
with the trace context itself (module 02's 'sampled' field), never re-looked-up
per span. Volume here is requests/sec x 20 services x sample_rate: write-once,
almost never updated, sharded by trace_id so one trace is always a single-shard
read. Retention (TTL) and sample_rate, not the storage engine, are the real cost levers.
